name: Illinois Tool Works

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Illinois Tool Works logo.svg)

description: ITW is a decentralised group of 88 divisions in 49 countries making niche industrial products: welding equipment and consumables, commercial food-service equipment, car-industry fasteners and components, test and measurement and electronics equipment, polymers and fluids (adhesives, lubricants), construction fasteners and specialty packaging and marking products. It makes money by selling engineered products and recurring consumables and service, with the 80/20 process used in every division to concentrate on the largest customers and products and cut complexity. That produces a 26 percent operating margin, well above a typical industrial group. It reports seven segments, the biggest being Automotive OEM (20 percent of revenue).

employees.note: About 43,000 people, about 16,000 in the US; 88 divisions in 49 countries.

businessLines.name: Automotive OEM
businessLines.how: Sells plastic and metal components, fasteners and assemblies to automotive OEMs and tier suppliers, programme-by-programme on multi-year supply awards; volume follows vehicle build rates.

businessLines.name: Food Equipment
businessLines.how: Sells warewashing, cooking, refrigeration and food-processing equipment to restaurants, grocers and institutions plus service, maintenance and repair (parts and service recur on installed equipment).

businessLines.name: Test & Measurement and Electronics
businessLines.how: Sells testing and measuring equipment, consumables and software and electronics assembly equipment and consumables to labs, manufacturers and electronics makers; one-time equipment sale plus recurring consumables and service.

businessLines.name: Welding
businessLines.how: Sells arc welding equipment, consumables and accessories to fabrication, shipbuilding, construction, energy and MRO customers; equipment sale followed by repeat consumable (wire, electrode) purchases.

businessLines.name: Polymers & Fluids
businessLines.how: Sells engineered adhesives, sealants, lubricants, cutting fluids and auto aftermarket maintenance and appearance products to industrial, MRO and auto-aftermarket customers; repeat consumable orders.

businessLines.name: Construction Products
businessLines.how: Sells fasteners, anchors, fastening tools and truss components to residential, remodel and commercial construction channels, including retail packaged hardware; volume tied to housing and construction activity.

businessLines.name: Specialty Products
businessLines.how: Sells beverage packaging equipment and consumables (can and bottle multi-pack plastics), product coding and marking equipment and consumables, appliance components and airport ground support equipment; equipment plus recurring consumables.

brands.name: 88 divisions in 49 countries
brands.note: Decentralised operating units grouped into seven segments; the 10-K names no individual brands or division revenues in the sections read.
